TOPIC FOR TOPIC RUN
Crowd percentages are consistent game estimates derived from answer familiarity, not claims about a real survey. Quick Crowd and Daily use everyday prompts only; specialist questions stay in Topic Run. Trump Mode is an exaggerated parody mode with fictional game-estimated crowd answers, not a real survey of Trump supporters. Unlisted-but-valid answers can be learned locally as long-tail responses.
